column1: # Rung 1 and rung 4 on the capped reference bank (2026-10-23; the user).
# Decision: the reference bank caps every deposit at 1% of the bank's total
# is the no-concentration counterfactual (r4-s1-s10, r1c-stale-y50-s1); super-
# individuals are the later, faithful fix. Why: at N = 1,000 a sigma 2.5 bank has a
# last-straw depositor (median largest share 15%) whom no partial grid makes split
# (F12d), and N would have to approach the platform's size to remove it
# The arms are r1c-* (arms/rung1_cara.tsv) plus the cap, tag r1k-*, same seed
# offset and common seeding, so each pairs run for run with its r1c arm (the cap is
# deterministic: same draws, deposits above L lowered to L). The confirmatory
# rung-1 set (base, agree, stale y0 20/50/80) and the G3c channel arms; corrects
# (dropped from the sweep) and tracks-g20 (exploratory) are not repeated.
# r1k-none is also rung 4's primary arm (S1-S4 on the capped bank).
